about: Hollerhorn Distilling is Karl and Melissa Neubauer’s farm distillery, tasting room and music venue outside Naples, in the valley south of Canandaigua Lake. Karl, who grew up in Naples and spent decades building houses, studied with master distillers for years before opening in 2018. His guiding idea is that a spirit should taste of where it comes from: by his count, almost everything Hollerhorn uses is grown within forty miles of the still.

Malt in Motion makes that point with barley. It is 100% barley grown in the Naples Valley, malted a few miles north by Murmuration Malts in Bloomfield, New York, then mashed, fermented and distilled in Naples. The whiskey is finished in several different casks before bottling. As an American single malt it is made entirely from malted barley at a single distillery and matured in casks no larger than 700 liters. Hollerhorn describes it as sweet and layered, with vanilla, caramel, fig and baking spice and a long, complex finish.
facts: 100% Naples Valley barley, malted by Murmuration Malts (Bloomfield, NY)
